Welcome
HEADTEACHER'S WELCOME
A very warm welcome to the Stanton School website.
At Stanton School we are a fully inclusive, diverse, school which ensures that children become lifelong learners through an exciting and enriching curriculum.
Our website will have all the information you, and your child, will need while at Stanton School and we encourage you to check regularly for school updates and events. Our core values of building the foundations for success are at the heart of all we do.
We hope our website gives you a taste of life at Stanton and how proud we are of our school. If you are interested to find out more and would like a tour to see our wonderful facilities, children and staff in action, please contact the school office to make an appointment.
Miss Helen Nicholson

Music Development Plan
At Stanton School we aim for all our pupils to develop a life-long love of music, in a school with a musical atmosphere through a wide range of quality musical experiences which engage and inspire them. At the heart of the music curriculum are creativity, curiosity and excitement and children who are developing increased self-confidence, self-esteem and collaborative skills. We aim to build a curriculum with musical sound at the cornerstone with a progressive pathway for every child. Music opportunities will support children’s mental health and allow them time to express their emotions.
Children will perform, listen and analyse critically, sing, improvise and compose music and understand the musical elements as building blocks within music.

School Sports Premium
SPORTS PREMIUM FUNDING
Stanton School has been in receipt of additional government funding specified as 'Sport Premium' since its introduction in September 2013. We aim to utilise this extra funding to improve all aspects of Physical Activity. This includes maximising pupil progress, increasing participation in sport, professional development of staff and helping all our pupils to develop healthy lifestyles and positive attitudes towards Physical Education.
At Stanton School, we recognise the contribution of PE to the health and well-being of the children. We believe that an innovative, varied PE curriculum and extra-curricular opportunities have a positive influence on the concentration, attitude and academic achievement of all our children.

Breakfast Club
We have a Breakfast club which runs daily, Monday to Friday, from 7:45am at a cost of £2.50 each day.
As well as breakfast, the club provides a quiet place for the children to read and listen to stories, or other activities including board games, table football, listening to music and sports activities.
Places can be booked in advance via ParentMail.
